'''''Sungrazer''''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] that served as the headquarters for [[Sungrazer cooperative]], an organization that used [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] for [[Death/Legends|deadly]] risky [[Comet/Legends|comet]] mining. As of [[3963 BBY]], the ship hosted about 80 slaves of various [[Species/Legends|species]] that were forced to mine [[Thorilide/Legends|thorilide]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] on the comet in the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]].
